meta.title: Autumn Morning Market | Shinjuku Gyoen · October 10
meta.description: A little autumn, a little discovery. An autumn morning market on October 10, from 9 am to noon.

seasonNotice.title: A note on autumn colour
seasonNotice.body: Due to this year's prolonged heat waves, autumn colours may not be fully present by October 10. We hope that won't stop you from visiting our small autumn market in the heart of Tokyo.

hero.description:
A soft breeze through the trees.
Seasonal flavours, thoughtful crafts,
and a small autumn market in Shinjuku Gyoen.
hero.caption: A quiet moment, in an autumn garden.

about.title:
Wake a little earlier.
Meet a little autumn.
about.body: Step away from the everyday for a while. Discover the flavours of the season and the care of handmade things, with a whole morning to wander at your own pace.
about.detail: Pause over a cup of tea or find something lovely to take home. This one-morning market is an invitation to notice the small joys of autumn.
about.note: The market is free to enjoy. Normal garden admission applies separately.

market.title: Taste. Discover. Take a little home.
market.intro: Four ways to enjoy the season.

items.title: A taste of autumn
items.description: Chestnut treats, sweet-potato sweets and freshly baked delights. Follow the comforting aromas to a delicious morning detour.

items.title: Made with care
items.description: Ceramics, textiles and the warmth of wood. Find a thoughtfully made piece to bring a little autumn into your everyday.

items.title: A moment for tea
items.description: Fragrant roasted hojicha and seasonal teas. Settle in, breathe in the garden air and let the morning unfold a little more slowly.
items.image: A warm cup of tea and Japanese sweets

items.title: A garden wander
items.description: The shape of a leaf, shifting light, a bird's call. Walk and sketch your way through the garden to find your own autumn scene.
items.image: A garden path and a sketchbook

programme.title: A little journey, in three hours.
programme.intro: From nine until noon. Follow your curiosity.

items.title: The morning begins
items.description: Step into autumn as the garden opens. Start with the stalls that catch your eye.

items.title: Crafts and a cup of tea
items.description: Find something special, then take a break with a warming cup.

items.title: A gentle garden stroll
items.description: Carry the morning into a walk. Notice the small changes of the season.

items.title: Until another season
items.description: The market closes at noon. Your time in the garden can continue.

visit.title: Before your morning out.
visit.intro: The market is free to enjoy. Garden admission is charged separately.
visit.proof: Please bring proof of age or student status when using a discounted admission rate.
visit.closure: Closed Mondays, or the next weekday when Monday is a public holiday. Check the official website for temporary changes.
visit.checked: Garden information checked on September 23, 2026. Fees and opening arrangements may change. Please check official information before travelling.

access.intro: Choose one of three garden entrances to suit your journey.
